facts.raw_span: A 25-year-old woman presented with a painless lump in the left cheek, first noted nine months earlier
no toothache, numbness, or systemic symptoms
no significant medical history
left facial asymmetry without skin changes
a firm, mobile, non-tender mass approximately 4 cm in diameter, located deep in the left buccal space and extending below the zygomatic arch
no cervical lymphadenopathy was noted
a bulge of the left buccal mucosa; palpation confirmed a well-defined, firm, non-tender mass
An orthopantomogram showed no bony destruction of the mandible or maxilla
Ultrasonography of the left cheek demonstrated a discrete, well-demarcated, hypoechoic solid mass measuring 2.6 × 2.0 cm, overlying the parotid gland
Contrast-enhanced CT of the head and neck revealed a well-bordered, slightly enhancing soft-tissue tumor measuring 2.7 × 3.7 × 4.0 cm in the left buccal space
Fine-needle aspiration biopsy yielded a hypocellular sample with erythrocytes, histiocytes, and neutrophils but showed “no signs of malignancy”
An intraoral incisional biopsy demonstrated “wide fibroblast proliferation, extremely similar to a fibroma”
